protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: Confirmed. With CFG_WIDEVINE_PTA enabled, open_session() obtains ts_get_calling_session() and the vulnerable code dereferences session->ctx without first rejecting NULL. The implementation returns the next session-stack entry, so a direct Normal World open with no calling TA yields no caller. The accepted one-line fix adds !session before is_user_ta_ctx(), matching the CWE-476 denial-of-service mechanism; sibling PTAs at the BIC tree already reject a NULL caller.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: Confirmed. ad194957b67062673816128f89eededb83f4be5b is a single-parent commit that creates core/pta/widevine.c from /dev/null and first writes both ts_get_calling_session() and the unchecked is_user_ta_ctx(session->ctx). Targeted path history, pickaxe, and blame show no intervening writer before the fix.
protocol_checks.immediate_parent_absence: Confirmed. The sole parent is 64086346d6bc74681d0d0442c24ae21fbb88c749, whose tree has no core/pta/widevine.c; therefore the vulnerable lines are absent in the immediate parent.
protocol_checks.squash_member_decomposition: Confirmed not applicable. The BIC is single-parent and atomic for this flaw. PR 6379 exposes one source commit, 863430810f1db632dd21829fe3ac409f306892c2; it is not a master ancestor, while its Widevine blob 6f84c9edb9c2f4edc5396b8fcc34817a3a9b505c exactly matches the landed BIC blob. This is an equivalent rebased landing, not a squash aggregate requiring member decomposition.
protocol_checks.affected_fixed_release_membership: Confirmed. The BIC is contained by tags 4.2.0 and 4.10.0 but not 4.1.0, with git describe --contains resolving from 4.2.0-rc1. CVE.org currently marks CVE-2026-71967 PUBLISHED, versions 0 through 4.10.0 affected, and that exact git fix unaffected.
